sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你打造了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们两人才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: Oh, we have a really amazing guest on Office Ladies today.
sentences.zh: 噢，今天《办公室》女士节目迎来了一位非常棒的嘉宾。

sentences.en: All of you that listened to Work Bus last week know that today in the studio, we have Bryan Cranston.
sentences.zh: 听过上周《工作巴士》那期节目的朋友都知道，今天来到演播室的是布莱恩·科兰斯顿。

sentences.en: We cannot wait for you guys to hear this interview because, look, there are certain episodes of The Office that are just real big episodes, and they warrant extra time.
sentences.zh: 我们迫不及待想让你们听到这次采访，因为听着，有些《办公室》的剧集确实非常重要，值得我们花更多时间去探讨。

sentences.en: And Work Bus is definitely one of those.
sentences.zh: 《工作巴士》绝对就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, and we shared all about our experience on that bus, but we really felt like you needed to hear from the director as well.
sentences.zh: 没错，我们分享了在那辆巴士上的所有经历，但我们觉得你们也需要听听导演本人的讲述。

sentences.en: So we reached out to Bryan.
sentences.zh: 所以我们联系了布莱恩。

sentences.en: He was so kind and gracious.
He came into the studio and chatted all things Work Bus with us.
sentences.zh: 他来到演播室，和我们畅聊了关于《工作巴士》的一切。

sentences.en: Now, I know a lot of people know Bryan Cranston from his many acting roles.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多人通过布莱恩·科兰斯顿的众多演艺角色认识他。

sentences.en: He's been in film and television, and he's been on Broadway.
sentences.zh: 他出演过电影、电视剧，还登上过百老汇舞台。

sentences.en: You know, there's Malcolm in the Middle and Walter White on Breaking Bad, and he even won a Tony Award for the Broadway play all the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有《马尔科姆的一家》，《绝命毒师》里的沃尔特·怀特，他甚至凭借百老汇剧作《一路到底》赢得了托尼奖。

sentences.en: But Bryan is also a very accomplished director.
sentences.zh: 但布莱恩也是一位非常有成就的导演。

sentences.en: He directed episodes of Malcolm in the Middle, of Breaking Bad, Modern Family, Sneaky Pete, and his new series, Your Honor, on Showtime.
sentences.zh: 他执导过《马尔科姆的一家》、《绝命毒师》、《摩登家庭》、《诈欺担保人》，以及他在Showtime频道的新剧《法官大人》。

sentences.en: And, of course, this very epic, famous episode of The Office.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有这一集史诗般著名的《办公室》。

sentences.en: He is so much fun to talk to.
It was such a joy having him.
sentences.zh: 能邀请到他真是太开心了。

sentences.en: And, Jenna, you know what I was thinking?
sentences.zh: 对了，珍娜，你知道我在想什么吗？

sentences.en: We didn't bring this up to him, but I want him to direct our road trip movie, if we ever do it.
sentences.zh: 我们还没跟他提过，但如果我们要拍公路旅行电影的话，我想让他来执导。
我们甚至还没分享过这件事。

sentences.en: Have we shared about the fact that me, you, and Lee have a road trip idea?
sentences.zh: 我们有没有说过我和你还有李有个公路旅行的点子？

sentences.en: We came up with an idea for a road trip movie.
sentences.zh: 我们想出了一个公路旅行电影的构思。

sentences.en: Some of the hardest I have laughed in a long time was when the three of us were sitting at your dining table and we were pitching jokes.
sentences.zh: 我很久没笑得那么厉害了，当时我们三个坐在你的餐桌旁，互相抛梗。

sentences.en: Because, listen, you guys, this is a road trip movie about two gals that are, like, in their 50s.
sentences.zh: 因为听着，各位，这是一部关于两个五十多岁女性的公路旅行电影。

sentences.en: It has a mom detective's element to it, I have to say.
sentences.zh: 我得说，它还带有一点妈妈侦探的元素。

sentences.en: But would Bryan Cranston ever direct anything on the road again?
sentences.zh: 但布莱恩·科兰斯顿还会愿意再执导任何关于公路题材的作品吗？

sentences.en: I think after you listen to this interview, you might find that he would be very hesitant to do so.
sentences.zh: 我想听完这次采访，你可能会发现他会非常犹豫。

sentences.en: Well, listen, the office might have ruined him forever in directing anything in a moving vehicle again.
sentences.zh: 听着，办公室那次经历可能让他再也不敢执导任何在行驶车辆里的戏份了。

sentences.en: But let's let him tell you about it.
sentences.zh: 但还是让他亲自告诉你吧。

sentences.en: We're going to take a break.
And when we come back, our interview with Bryan Cranston about Work Bus, which is also known as Death Bus.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们将采访布莱恩·科兰斯顿，聊聊《工作巴士》，也就是大家口中的《死亡巴士》。
那真是一次很棒的采访。

sentences.en: See, well, who wrote your opening theme song?
sentences.zh: 话说，你们的开场主题曲是谁写的？

sentences.en: You know, I just realized who Creed was.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我刚意识到克里德是谁。

sentences.en: I just, in the, like, in the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 我就是，大概，就在过去几周里才意识到。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking, that can't be the same.
sentences.zh: 我在想，那不可能是同一个人吧。

sentences.en: Now, my question to you, my first question.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想问你，我的第一个问题。

sentences.en: Thanks for coming on the show, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，谢谢你来参加节目。

sentences.en: My first question to you would be, did the show ever do a backstage idea about what Creed's background was?
sentences.zh: 我的第一个问题是，剧组有没有做过关于克里德背景的幕后策划？

sentences.en: Did someone ever go, that guy looks so familiar?
sentences.zh: 有没有人说过，那家伙看起来好眼熟？

sentences.en: And, you know, did you ever do anything like that?
sentences.zh: 而且，你们有没有做过类似的事情？

sentences.en: There were so many people who wanted to do a whole episode just on Creed and his life and wanted him to be outed as Creed Bratton, Creed Bratton,
sentences.zh: 有很多人想专门拍一集关于克里德和他生活的剧集，想让他以克里德·布拉顿的身份曝光，就是克里德·布拉顿本人，

sentences.en: because he's the only person on the show who has his full name as his character name.
sentences.zh: 因为他是剧里唯一一个用真名作为角色名的人。

sentences.en: Like, Angela is Angela on the show, but on the show her last name is Martin.
sentences.zh: 比如，安吉拉在剧里叫安吉拉，但她的姓是马丁。

sentences.en: But Creed Bratton, the character, is also Creed Bratton, the man.
sentences.zh: 但克里德·布拉顿这个角色，就是克里德·布拉顿本人。

sentences.en: But I don't think it was ever revealed.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这从未被揭露过。

sentences.en: I will say, though, of all the characters, we have a show Bible.
sentences.zh: 不过我得说，在所有角色中，我们有一本剧集设定集。

sentences.en: You guys, Brian, his microphone's this morning.
sentences.zh: 你们看，布莱恩，他的麦克风今天早上。

sentences.en: And there is a bar in front of his face.
sentences.zh: 他脸前面挡着一根横杆。

sentences.en: And so for me to talk to Brian, he has to look.
sentences.zh: 所以我跟布莱恩说话时，他得看着。

sentences.en: Angela, it's safer to have a bar in front of my face.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我脸前面有根横杆更安全。

sentences.en: It helps the restraining order issue that we have.
sentences.zh: 这有助于解决我们之间的限制令问题。

sentences.en: But anyway, of all the characters, we had a show Bible of all their back history.
sentences.zh: 总之，在所有角色中，我们有一本记录他们背景历史的设定集。
而克里德的设定是最疯狂的。

sentences.en: It's the most fun to read.
He has like a family in Canada.
sentences.zh: 他在加拿大好像有个家庭。

sentences.en: He lives under his desk half the time.
sentences.zh: 他有一半时间都住在办公桌底下。

sentences.en: It's like all over the place.
Why didn't I get a chance to read that?
sentences.zh: 为什么我没机会读那个？

sentences.en: They didn't give you the show Bible?
sentences.zh: 他们没给你剧集指南吗？

sentences.en: No one said it was available.
You should have been given that.
sentences.zh: 你应该拿到那份文件的。

sentences.en: I absolutely should have been given that.
sentences.zh: 我绝对应该拿到那份文件的。
那会改变《工作巴士》这一集。

sentences.en: Well, we always like to ask people when they come on, first question, how did you end up working on The Office?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们总是喜欢问新加入的人，第一个问题，你是怎么最终参与到《办公室》制作的？

sentences.en: How'd you get this job directing WorkBus?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得到执导《工作巴士》这份工作的？

sentences.en: Tracy Katsky is a friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西·卡茨基是我的朋友。

sentences.en: And she was working as a consultant with David in the last year you guys were on the air.
sentences.zh: 在你们播出的最后一年，她和戴维一起担任顾问。

sentences.en: And I had just finished my season with Breaking Bad, and that was 2012.
sentences.zh: 我刚拍完《绝命毒师》那一季，那是2012年的事。

sentences.en: And Tracy calls and says, we're looking for directors for this new season.
sentences.zh: 然后特蕾西打电话来说，我们正在为新一季寻找导演。

sentences.en: Would you be interested in coming on board The Office?
sentences.zh: 你有兴趣加入《办公室》吗？

sentences.en: And immediately the answer was going to be, of course, no.
sentences.zh: 我当时的第一个念头当然是拒绝。

sentences.en: It's such a legendary show that any chance to be a part of it in some small way.
sentences.zh: 这是一部如此传奇的剧集，任何能以某种微小方式参与其中的机会（我都不会错过）。

sentences.en: And she said, I know you've been directing Breaking Bad's, and you know, you're out in the desert, and it's hot, and it's sticky.
sentences.zh: 她说，我知道你一直在执导《绝命毒师》，你知道的，你在沙漠里，又热又黏。

sentences.en: How would you like to come to, what was it, Burbank, North Hollywood, wherever we were?
sentences.zh: 你想不想来，是什么地方来着，伯班克，北好莱坞，不管我们在哪儿？

sentences.en: Air-conditioned, easy, indoors, five days, bang, bang, bang.
sentences.zh: 有空调，轻松，室内，五天，搞定，搞定，搞定。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, it sounds fantastic.
And she said, well, we have such and such slot open.
sentences.zh: 她说，好吧，我们有某某档期空着。

sentences.en: And I looked at my calendar, and I said, I'll take that slot.
sentences.zh: 我看了看日历，说，我要那个档期。

sentences.en: And I don't know, you probably described it on your show before, but the way it works in television for directors is by time.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，你可能在你的节目里描述过，但电视剧导演的工作方式是按时间排的。

sentences.en: You have no idea when you sign on to a show what your episode is going to be by the time it gets to your time slot.
sentences.zh: 当你签约一部剧时，你根本不知道轮到你的时候会拍哪一集。

sentences.en: And it just so happened that Work Bus came onto my lap.
sentences.zh: 结果刚好《工作巴士》落到了我手里。

sentences.en: What did you think when you read this episode?
sentences.zh: 你读到这一集时是怎么想的？

sentences.en: Well, the first, I was excited to read it, read it right away, and Work Bus, oh, I don't know, oh, they exterminate, was it exterminating?
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我很兴奋能读到它，立刻就读了，关于《工作巴士》，哦，我不知道，哦，他们要灭虫，是灭虫吗？

sentences.en: No, we were exterminating, this was 11 years ago, I think.
sentences.zh: 不，我们要灭虫，那是11年前的事了，我想。

sentences.en: There was this electrical issue, electromagnetic things in the walls, and Dwight was going to have to open up all the walls and redo the electrical.
sentences.zh: 当时有电力问题，墙里有电磁干扰，德怀特不得不拆开所有的墙重新布线。

sentences.en: So the basic idea is that there could not be a work stoppage for the whole team.
sentences.zh: 所以基本构思是整个团队不能停工。

sentences.en: So a work bus was found to be the best method to continue working while this work on the actual location, the office, was taking place.
sentences.zh: 因此，在办公室原址施工期间，一辆工作巴士被认为是继续工作的最佳方案。

sentences.en: So everybody had to load onto the bus, desks were on there, as we all know, and we had to just keep traveling.
sentences.zh: 所以大家都得挤上那辆巴士，正如我们所知，课桌也在上面，我们只能不停地赶路。

sentences.en: We're in the San Fernando Valley in AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 我们八月份在圣费尔南多谷拍摄。

sentences.en: I went to the call sheets, it was 100 degrees this week.
sentences.zh: 我看了通告单，这周气温有100华氏度。

sentences.en: So the first thing I did was curse my friend Tracy Katzky and say, damn you, as if they knew, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我做的第一件事就是咒骂我的朋友特蕾西·卡茨基，说该死，就好像他们知道一样，你知道的。

sentences.en: I think we shot in on the set for a day and a half or something like that.
sentences.zh: 我想我们在片场大概拍了一天半左右。

sentences.en: And then the rest of the time we were on that bus or in the park.
sentences.zh: 剩下的时间我们都在那辆巴士上或者公园里。

sentences.en: And then we were at a baseball field, I know.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还在一个棒球场拍过，我记得。

sentences.en: We had that cold open, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们拍了那个开场戏，对。

sentences.en: I enjoyed it for the most part.
sentences.zh: 大部分时间我还是很享受的。
当然也有一些艰难的时刻。

sentences.en: Well, I have to say, okay, you know that our cast has renamed this episode Death Bus.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我得说，你知道我们的演员阵容把这一集重新命名为“死亡巴士”了吗。

sentences.en: This has come to you, I know.
sentences.zh: 这事儿传到你那儿了吧，我知道。

sentences.en: And Jenna and I wrote a whole chapter in our book about it, The Office PFFs.
sentences.zh: 珍娜和我在我们的书《办公室PFFs》里专门写了一整章关于它的内容。

sentences.en: We have a copy for you.
Inside it says, Brian, we owe you our lives.
sentences.zh: 里面写着：布莱恩，我们欠你一条命。

sentences.en: And we dedicated a whole chapter to just this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们专门用了一整章来写这一集。

sentences.en: And we have fantastic photos of you.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还有你的精彩照片。

sentences.en: But we realized after our book came out, you were doing press.
sentences.zh: 但书出版后我们才意识到，你当时正在做宣传。

sentences.en: We felt really bad because every single producer clearly wanted you to be asked about Death Bus.
sentences.zh: 我们感到很内疚，因为每个制片人显然都想让你被问到关于“死亡巴士”的问题。

sentences.en: Jenna was like, oh, no, Ange.
We wrote about this and now everyone is asking him the same question on every talk show.
sentences.zh: 我们写了这件事，现在每个人在每个脱口秀节目上都问他同样的问题。

sentences.en: Why did you try to kill the cast of The Office?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要试图谋杀《办公室》的演员们？

sentences.en: Why did I try to kill the cast?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要试图谋杀演员们？

sentences.en: Was it a murder for hire?
Was it a failed murder for hire?
sentences.zh: 那是失败的雇凶杀人吗？

sentences.en: I can't discuss all those details.
There is a current investigation going on.
And, you know, indictments will be handed down.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，起诉书将会下达。

sentences.en: I have every reason to believe you two are in the clear.
sentences.zh: 我有充分的理由相信你们两个是清白的。

sentences.en: I can't be positive on that.
You know, you talk about the set being contained.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你提到过片场空间很封闭。

sentences.en: And we didn't have a lot of room.
And if I recall, nothing was actually nailed down.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，当时什么东西都没固定住。

sentences.en: Everything was kind of shifting around.
sentences.zh: 所有东西都在晃来晃去。

sentences.en: Desks were actually shifting and moving.
sentences.zh: 办公桌都在位移和移动。

sentences.en: And I'm looking at this going, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我看着这一切，心想，天哪。

sentences.en: I think people didn't realize this bus is actually on the road, on an open street and moving.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大家都没意识到这辆车是真的行驶在开放道路上的。

sentences.en: Well, at first there was comedy in that, right?
sentences.zh: 起初这还挺搞笑的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, at first, we're traveling down the road and, like, our little coffee cup is moving across the desk.
sentences.zh: 就像我们刚开始在路上行驶时，我们的小咖啡杯就在桌子上滑来滑去。

sentences.en: My lamp slid in my lap.
sentences.zh: 我的台灯滑到了我腿上。

sentences.en: But then there was a part of the script where, I guess, Dwight swerves and we all kind of slide and we all are like, ah.
sentences.zh: 但剧本里有一段戏，我想是德怀特猛打方向盘，我们所有人都滑向一边，然后大家都在喊，啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's trying to get us to the pie.
sentences.zh: 没错，他当时正试图带我们去吃派。

sentences.en: And I guess the AD yelled to the cast, we weren't really swerving, lean right.
sentences.zh: 我记得助理导演当时冲演员喊，我们其实没在猛打方向盘，让大家往右倾斜。

sentences.en: And we kind of, ah, and no one bought it.
sentences.zh: 于是我们都做了个“啊”的动作，但没人信服。

sentences.en: Rain left and a stunt driver got on the bus.
sentences.zh: 雷恩离开了，换上了一名特技车手来开公交车。

sentences.en: They removed us from the tow rig and now we are truly just a bus traveling down the road with a stunt driver.
sentences.zh: 他们把我们从拖车装置上卸下来，现在我们真的是一辆由特技车手驾驶在路上的公交车了。

sentences.en: We listed what all was in the bus.
sentences.zh: 我们列出了车里所有的东西。

sentences.en: Like we went back and screen grabbed it.
It was a full like Arrowhead water jug dispenser, a microwave, a coffee pot, lamps, rolling chairs, desks, computers, a printer.
sentences.zh: 里面有完整的箭牌饮水机、微波炉、咖啡壶、台灯、转椅、办公桌、电脑和打印机。

sentences.en: Was there a little mini Xerox machine?
sentences.zh: 还有一台小型施乐复印机吗？

sentences.en: So it was a full office and it all, when the stunt driver swerved right, it all swerved.
sentences.zh: 所以那是一个完整的办公室，当特技车手向右猛打方向盘时，所有东西都跟着晃动了。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, that was not part of the production discussion that we had, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这根本不在我们之前的制作讨论范围内。

sentences.en: It was like, we're doing this, rain's going to drive and we're going to do this and it's all contained and we'll have the cast move back and forth.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，我们来拍这个，雷恩开车，我们来演这段，一切都在可控范围内，让演员们跟着晃动就行。

sentences.en: And there was something funny about things happening at the same time and once.
sentences.zh: 而那种所有东西同时发生晃动的感觉才更有趣。
那种效果是无法复制的。

sentences.en: And so there was an idea, and I don't believe it was my idea, but I'm not saying it's not, to actually heighten the movement of the thing with a professional stunt driver.
sentences.zh: 于是有人提议——我不确定是不是我提的，但也可能是——让专业的特技车手来加大车辆的晃动幅度。

sentences.en: Yes, it was a professional stunt driver.

sentences.en: Aaron – well, here's – Aaron and I, three years after the end of Breaking Bad, we missed each other.
sentences.zh: 亚伦——嗯，是这样——亚伦和我，在《绝命毒师》完结三年后，我们都很想念彼此。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's like when you leave –
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，就像当你离开——

sentences.en: And you're together, you're together, you're together.
sentences.zh: 你们一直在一起，一直在一起，一直在一起。

sentences.en: It ends and life goes on and sends you in different directions.
sentences.zh: 剧集结束了，生活还要继续，把你们带向了不同的方向。

sentences.en: And we happened to be in New York City at the same time.
sentences.zh: 碰巧我们当时都在纽约市。

sentences.en: And we have to have dinner.
sentences.zh: 于是我们必须一起吃顿饭。
所以我们当时正在吃晚饭。

sentences.en: And we expressed how much we missed each other.
sentences.zh: 我们表达了彼此是多么想念对方。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, what we ought to do is have a company.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，我们应该一起开家公司。

sentences.en: We ought to, you know, we ought to have a mezcal company together.
sentences.zh: 我们应该，你知道，我们应该一起开一家梅斯卡尔酒公司。

sentences.en: I go, what are you – that's random.
sentences.zh: 我说，你这是——这太突兀了。

sentences.en: That shitty spirit with a dead worm at the bottom out of – what are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 那种底部有死虫子的烂酒——你在说什么啊？

sentences.en: And he goes, no, no, no, no.
He took me to a mezcal bar in New York City.
sentences.zh: 他带我去了纽约市的一家梅斯卡尔酒吧。

sentences.en: We sipped some of the greatest spirits that I've ever had.
sentences.zh: 我们品尝了一些我喝过最棒的烈酒。

sentences.en: I don't think I've ever had mezcal.
sentences.zh: 我想我从来没喝过梅斯卡尔酒。

sentences.en: It's the older brother of tequila.
sentences.zh: 它是龙舌兰酒的“老大哥”。
龙舌兰酒属于梅斯卡尔酒的一种。

sentences.en: But mezcal is not a tequila.
sentences.zh: 但梅斯卡尔酒不一定是龙舌兰酒。

sentences.en: A spirit like that that's made from an agave plant is always a mezcal.
sentences.zh: 像那种用龙舌兰植物制成的烈酒，统称为梅斯卡尔酒。

sentences.en: And the way they make tequila is to steam it and put it in a silo and it's more of a fast process.
sentences.zh: 而龙舌兰酒的制作方式是将其蒸熟并放入筒仓，这是一种更快速的工艺。
梅斯卡尔酒是烟熏过的。

sentences.en: And so it's in an earthen pit for four days and then mashed.
sentences.zh: 所以它要在土坑里埋四天，然后再捣碎。

sentences.en: In fact, ours – we have – it says artisanal on the bottle.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们的酒——我们有——瓶子上写着“手工制作”。

sentences.en: And there's no modern technology used in the process of this or else we can't say that on the bottle.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个过程中不能使用任何现代技术，否则我们就不能在瓶子上那样标注。

sentences.en: It goes from that to a rock pit where two donkeys pull this big rock wheel and mash this now smoked agave.
sentences.zh: 它从那里被送到一个石坑，两头驴拉着巨大的石轮，把这些已经烟熏过的龙舌兰捣碎。

sentences.en: Then it's – then it ferments in an oak barrel for 10 days.
sentences.zh: 然后它会在橡木桶里发酵10天。

sentences.en: And then it goes into a copper kettle for a distillation.
sentences.zh: 然后它会被放入铜壶中进行蒸馏。

sentences.en: And that's the purity of it.
It's mountain spring water and smoked agave.
sentences.zh: 它是山泉水和烟熏龙舌兰。

sentences.en: And it's done – Dos Hombres is now the fifth largest mezcal in the world.
sentences.zh: 就这样完成了——Dos Hombres 现在是世界上第五大梅斯卡尔酒品牌。

sentences.en: I have – we have to try it.
We're going to go get some.
I will bring it to you.
I will bring it to you.
Also, just your description of it.
I felt like I left my body for a minute.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己刚才灵魂出窍了一会儿。

sentences.en: It felt like I went on a little vacation.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像去度了个小假。

sentences.en: We found this spirit and brought it to the marketplace.
sentences.zh: 我们发现了这种烈酒，并把它带到了市场上。

sentences.en: And in truth, the spirit found us because it's been around for hundreds of years and
sentences.zh: 事实上，是这种烈酒找到了我们，因为它已经存在几百年了，而

sentences.en: we were just there to receive it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是恰好在那里接收它。

sentences.en: This sounds like a pretty good start on the project of Living Life.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是“活出生活”这个项目的一个相当不错的开始。

sentences.en: But like any other business, it takes a lot of effort and a lot of time and energy.
sentences.zh: 但就像任何其他生意一样，它需要付出大量的努力、时间和精力。

sentences.en: Probably more than you expected when you started.
sentences.zh: 可能比你刚开始时预想的要多得多。

sentences.en: And it's a lot of work.
And I find that the business end of it, the case cells and this and that, it's not as
sentences.zh: 我发现它的商业运作部分，比如销售案例之类的，对我来说

sentences.en: interesting to me as the process of making it and that nurturing sense.
sentences.zh: 不如制作过程和那种培育感来得有趣。

sentences.en: Yeah, that and I'm – I have a production company and that's interesting too.
sentences.zh: 是啊，还有我——我有一家制作公司，那也很有趣。

sentences.en: But I'm now looking for ways to have more of that human, real life experience.
sentences.zh: 但我现在正在寻找方法，去获得更多那种真实的人文生活体验。

sentences.en: I have a crazy question for you.
sentences.zh: 我有个疯狂的问题要问你。

sentences.en: Did you ever in your young artist life ever do that book, The Artist's Way?
sentences.zh: 在你年轻的艺术家生涯中，有没有读过那本《艺术家之路》？
朱莉娅·卡梅隆写的那本？

sentences.en: I did a few pages of it.
And how did the few pages go?
I did it twice because the first time I didn't finish and it bothered me so deeply because
sentences.zh: 我做了两次，因为第一次我没做完，这让我非常困扰，因为

sentences.en: I realized that one of my challenges in my early artistic life was having great – tons
sentences.zh: 我意识到我早期艺术生涯中的挑战之一就是有很棒的——大量的

sentences.en: of great ideas of which I finished none.
sentences.zh: 很棒的想法，但我一个都没完成。

sentences.en: And so I thought I need to get over this finishing things problem.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，我得克服这个无法完成任务的问题。

sentences.en: Why don't I start by finishing The Artist's Way?
sentences.zh: 为什么我不从完成《艺术家之路》开始呢？

sentences.en: And so I had done 10 of the 12 weeks and I went back and I started over again.
sentences.zh: 于是我完成了12周里的10周，然后我又回去从头开始。

sentences.en: And there are still things from that book, even today as an artist, that I think of.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，作为一名艺术家，我依然会想起那本书里的内容。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things is once a week you have to go on an artist's date.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一件事就是你每周必须进行一次“艺术家约会”。

sentences.en: That could be going to a symphony.
That could be sitting in a park and watching people.
sentences.zh: 那可以是坐在公园里观察行人。

sentences.en: Like, whatever your artist's date is, you have to do this once a week.
sentences.zh: 总之，无论你的“艺术家约会”是什么，你每周都必须做一次。

sentences.en: And so sometimes when I'm, like, starting a new artistic journey or whatever, I'll refer
sentences.zh: 所以有时当我开始一段新的艺术旅程或类似的事情时，我会参考

sentences.en: back and I'll do an artist's date and I'll try to kickstart something.
sentences.zh: 回去做一次“艺术家约会”，试着激发一些灵感。

sentences.en: It's that business of living life, right?

sentences.zh: 打保龄球那点让我有点意外。

sentences.en: The bowling – that's an artist's date if you want it to be.
sentences.zh: 打保龄球——如果你愿意的话，那也是一种“艺术家约会”。

sentences.en: To be fair, the week I got the book –
sentences.zh: 平心而论，我拿到那本书的那周——

sentences.en: It was the week of my birthday when I got this book as a gift, but I also got a pair
sentences.zh: 我收到这本书作为礼物时正好是我的生日周，但我还收到了一双

sentences.en: And I was a child of the 70s and I loved roller skating.
sentences.zh: 我是70年代的孩子，我热爱滑旱冰。

sentences.en: And then I think I started it and then I was like, I'm going to go roller skate.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时刚开始看书，然后我就想，我要去滑旱冰。

sentences.en: That could be an artist's date.
sentences.zh: 那也可以是一次“艺术家约会”。

sentences.en: It was an artist's date that never stopped.
sentences.zh: 那是一次从未停止的“艺术家约会”。

sentences.en: It was an artist's date that never –
I still have the same pair of roller skates.
sentences.zh: 我至今还留着那双旱冰鞋。
它们就在我家前门旁边。

sentences.en: That's got to be something, Jenna.
That came out of the artist's way for me.
sentences.zh: 那是艺术家特意为我创作的。

sentences.en: I think it came out of your birthday.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是源于你的生日。

sentences.en: My birthday buddy is Ricky Gervais.
sentences.zh: 我的生日伙伴是瑞奇·热维斯。

sentences.en: Does she share our birthday as well?
sentences.zh: 她也和我们同一天生日吗？
我们应该办个三月七日聚会。
比茜·菲利普斯和我同一天生日。

sentences.en: You, Busy Phillips, Ricky Gervais are going to have dinner.
sentences.zh: 你、比茜·菲利普斯、瑞奇·热维斯，你们要一起吃顿饭。
我很乐意参加那场晚宴。

sentences.en: And then we'll have dinner with Rachel.
sentences.zh: 然后我们再和蕾切尔一起吃顿饭。

sentences.en: You have a dinner with all the people who share the date and you find the similarities
sentences.zh: 你和所有同一天生日的人聚餐，然后找出你们之间的相似之处

sentences.en: and the differences between them, but they all have the same birthday.
sentences.zh: 和不同之处，但你们的生日都是同一天。

sentences.en: Brian, you have a production company.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩，你有一家制作公司。

sentences.en: We're putting you to work again.
sentences.zh: 我们又让你开始干活了。

sentences.en: Rather than that, let me give it to you and I take 10%.
sentences.zh: 与其这样，不如我把它交给你，我抽成百分之十。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming in today.
It was so good to see you again.
You know, this episode, it was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，这一集，真的很美。

sentences.en: I just rewatched it and it's so good.
sentences.zh: 我刚重温了一遍，真的太好了。

sentences.en: Even though we all almost died, it's a great episode and it's a classic and people love it
sentences.zh: 尽管我们当时差点没命，但这集真的很棒，是个经典，大家都喜欢它
而且他们还不知道（当时的情况）。

sentences.en: And now when people see us fly across the bus, I think we needed that moment.
sentences.zh: 现在当人们看到我们从公交车上飞出去时，我觉得我们需要那一刻。
我觉得我们确实需要它。

sentences.en: I think it made the pie that much sweeter.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这让派变得更甜了。
这就是实际拍摄的那一段。

sentences.en: And now you can relive it in our book.
sentences.zh: 现在你们可以在我们的书里重温那一刻了。

sentences.en: I'm going to bring you some Dos Hombres and we'll all sip some.
sentences.zh: 我要带些Dos Hombres龙舌兰酒来，我们一起喝点。

sentences.en: Do you have it on ice?
You know, any way you like it is the right way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论你怎么喝，只要你喜欢就是对的。

sentences.en: Maybe one big ice cube and just let it chill without diluting it and just sip it.
sentences.zh: 也许加一块大冰块，让它变凉而不稀释它，然后慢慢品尝。

sentences.en: It's so great just sipping it.
sentences.zh: 慢慢品尝的感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: It goes in a cocktail as well.
sentences.zh: 它也可以用来做鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: It goes so well in a margarita, in a paloma, in an old-fashioned, a negroni.
sentences.zh: 它非常适合做玛格丽特、帕洛玛、古典鸡尾酒和尼格罗尼。

sentences.zh: 我真是太享受这次采访了，安吉拉。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢布莱恩来到演播室，并慷慨地抽出时间陪伴我们。
